abstract: The Ultra High-Definition Alliance (UHDA) strives to deliver a premium home entertainment experience, including maintaining the original filmmaker's creative intent. To that end, the UHDA launched Filmmaker Mode® several years ago–a TV picture mode that disables certain post-processing features such as motion smoothing, sharpening, noise reduction, and others to ensure that content is delivered to consumers without any alterations by the display.
